frequency_question: What proportion of regulatory rulemakings or adjustments to the countercyclical capital buffer can complete the necessary administrative process within an 85-day window?
membership_rule: Includes any Federal Reserve Board regulatory action altering capital requirements, capital buffers, or macroprudential tools. Excludes standard monetary policy interest rate adjustments.

coverage_note: 4 named major capital framework rulemakings; exhaustive for modern structural capital buffer adjustments.
known_gaps: None; administrative procedure requirements for substantive rule changes are legally mandated.
skeleton: Regulatory adjustments of this magnitude require inter-agency coordination, a Board vote to propose, a public comment period (typically 60 to 90 days minimum), review of comments, and a final vote. The pure administrative clock time for any substantive rule change exceeds 85 days.
multiplier: 0 steps out of 4 completed within 85 days for substantive capital buffer changes.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act and internal Federal Reserve governance rules change very slowly.
